prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout displaying the pet preview on one side and official details on the other.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column"}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Video Preview Audio Flow: Introduce a video and sound preview component flow on the pick friend screen to let users hear and see animated pet behaviors before adopting.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_vid", "style": "plain", "action": "play"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:pet_voice_snd", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Choose Path Story Checklist Flow: Transform the story screen into an interactive checklist layout showing upcoming setup milestones.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Select your companion path", "style": "subtle"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Mascot Sound Progress Flow: Add a mascot component accompanied by audio feedback sound when background rendering completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_helper", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:ready_chime", "style": "emphasis", "action": "play"}]}}
4: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Desktop Access Progress Notification: Add step progress and notification indicator on the sign-in screen to clarify account authentication progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
5: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Audio Greeting Incentive: Add a welcome mascot and interactive audio greeting badge on the home intro screen to celebrate setup completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:welcome_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Pet Ready!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Step Counter Progress Display: Display step counter and remaining time estimate on the story screen to orient new users.
   config: {"story": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
7: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Mascot Visual Helper: Add a visual mascot helper with hint text on the photo upload screen to guide custom pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload a clear, front-facing photo for the best desktop pet rendering.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:photo_guide_mascot", "style": "calm"}]}}
8: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Layout: Update the waiting screen layout to checklist format displaying background generation status items.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "show_progress": true}}
9: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign: Update the sign-in screen layout to checklist format showing account backup benefits.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "checklist"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining pet and official details is allowed.
Adding video and audio preview components to the pick friend screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Transforming the story screen into a setup milestone checklist removes its required job of introducing the pet.
Adding mascot audio progress feedback to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding step progress indicators and ready notifications to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Adding a welcome mascot and badge component to the home intro overlay is permitted.
Displaying a step counter and time estimate on the story screen is allowed.
Adding a mascot helper with photo guidelines to the upload photos screen is allowed.
Using a checklist layout to show pet generation status retains the waiting screen's job.
Updating the sign-in layout to a checklist displaying backup benefits is permitted.
